Triggers: UE receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with the reregistration required indication.
UE needs to perform the registration procedure for initial registration for emergency services.
Release of the N1 NAS signalling connection.
UE in NBN1 mode is requested by the upper layer to transmit user data related to an exceptional event and the UE is allowed to use exception data reporting and timer T3346 was not started.

UE needs to perform the registration procedure with 5GS registration type IE set to initial registration for initiating of an emergency PDU session upon request of the upper layers to establish the emergency PDU session.
States: EMM-DEREGISTERED (after intersystem change from S1 mode)
Actions: UE sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message including the NAS message container IE as part of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
UE NAS provides the lower layers with a GUAMI part of the 5GGUTI mapped from 4GGUTI with an indication that the GUAMI is mapped from EPS.
UE shall attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or initiate an initial registration.
Flow_of_execution: UE determines the need for initial registration.
UE constructs and sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE may include the REGISTRATION REQUEST message within a NAS message container IE.
UE may perform security mode procedure.
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REGISTRATION REJECT message.
Causes: Exceptional event reporting in NBN1 mode.
Intersystem change from S1 mode to N1 mode.
Expected_Outcomes: Re-establishment of previously established PDU sessions.
Error_Handling: Aborting the registration procedure if lower layer failure or release of the NAS signalling connection is received before REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REGISTRATION REJECT.
Initiating UE-initiated deregistration procedure if required.

Handling 5GMM parameters and 5GMM state for the other access if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the UE also supports the registration procedure over the other access.
Feedback_Loops: UE attempts to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or initiate an initial registration after network-initiated deregistration.
UE resets the registration attempt counter if a registration procedure was performed and the 5GMM cause value received is #11.

UE handles EMM parameters EMM state EPS update status EPS attach attempt counter tracking area updating attempt counter or service request attempt counter 4GGUTI TAI list eKSI as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 for the case when the EPS attach tracking area updating procedure or service request procedure is rejected with the EMM cause of the same value in a NAS message without integrity protection if the 5GMM cause value received is #11 and the UE is operating in singleregistration mode.
UE sets the SNPNspecific attempt counter for the current SNPN to the UE implementationspecific maximum value if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS.

metadata.Message_Types: REGISTRATION REQUEST, REGISTRATION ACCEPT, REGISTRATION REJECT, DEREGISTRATION REQUEST, SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
metadata.Excerpts: The UE shall send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the network and enter the state 5GMMDEREGISTERED for non3GPP access. Furthermore the UE shall after the completion of the deregistration procedure and the release of the existing NAS signalling connection initiate an initial registration over non3GPP.
